profile.name: Sriram M
profile.tagline: I build AI systems that ship — not just notebooks that demo.
profile.bio: AI/ML Engineer specializing in Generative AI, LLM applications, and production-grade machine learning systems. I build RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, fine-tuned LLMs, and computer vision models — then take them the rest of the way with FastAPI, Docker, and MLOps, instead of leaving them in a notebook.

experience.summary: Built and shipped production ML/GenAI features across chatbots, forecasting, and MLOps pipelines.
highlights: Built and deployed an NLP-based customer support chatbot using FastAPI and LangChain, reducing average query resolution time by ~40% across 500+ daily user interactions.
Developed a predictive analytics model for business forecasting using XGBoost, achieving AUC-ROC of 0.91 after iterative feature engineering on a 150K-row dataset.
Designed real-time ML inference REST API endpoints supporting concurrent requests with sub-200ms response latency using async FastAPI.
Automated a data preprocessing and model retraining pipeline using Celery and Redis, cutting pipeline turnaround time from 4 hours to 45 minutes.
Containerized AI applications with Docker and deployed to AWS EC2 across 3 internal business use cases.
Maintained CI/CD pipelines for ML model versioning and deployment using Git and MLflow.

projects.title: Enterprise Multi-Agent RAG Knowledge Assistant
projects.subtitle: Production-grade multi-agent RAG platform
projects.description: Autonomous query routing, hybrid retrieval, and memory built on LangGraph and LangChain. Hybrid search (HF embeddings + BM25 + cross-encoder reranking) with RRF fusion and HyDE improved retrieval precision by 31% while cutting hallucinations. Evaluated with RAGAS, deployed on FastAPI + Redis + Docker + AWS with streaming, human-in-the-loop approval, and real-time monitoring.

projects.title: Customer Support LLM Fine-Tuning
projects.subtitle: QLoRA fine-tune on 150K+ support conversations
projects.description: Fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B using QLoRA on historical customer support conversations and product documentation, improving intent understanding and reducing incorrect responses by 32% over the base model. Built an automated preprocessing, evaluation, and deployment pipeline.

projects.title: Gym Membership Retention Automation Platform
projects.subtitle: AI-powered retention platform on n8n
projects.description: AI-powered gym membership retention platform with a React frontend and n8n automation workflows managing memberships, attendance, renewals, and engagement. Automated renewal reminders, inactivity follow-ups, personalized WhatsApp/email campaigns, and lead qualification, plus a real-time retention dashboard.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction ML System
projects.subtitle: XGBoost churn pipeline with monitoring
projects.description: End-to-end ML pipeline to predict customer churn from structured business data, including preprocessing, feature engineering, and class-imbalance handling. Compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost, deployed the best model through a monitored FastAPI service with Pytest coverage.

projects.title: AI Virtual Mouse Using Hand Gestures
projects.subtitle: Touch-free cursor control via computer vision
projects.description: Real-time AI-powered virtual mouse using OpenCV, MediaPipe, and PyAutoGUI for touch-free cursor control. Implemented gesture-based cursor movement, clicks, drag-and-drop, and scrolling with smooth, low-latency hand landmark tracking.

education.institution: PSG College of Arts and Science, Coimbatore
